risks.risk: Cylinders may be expired or near expiration
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the date stamp on the cylinder, ideally showing the full date and expiry date.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially expired, which reduces value significantly

risks.risk: Cylinders may have internal damage or corrosion not visible from the outside
risks.proof: A photo showing the inside of the cylinder, or a close-up of the valve and base for signs of corrosion or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially compromised, reducing value

risks.risk: Cylinders may not be in working condition (e.g., valve not sealing, pressure gauge missing)
risks.proof: A photo of the valve and pressure gauge, or a video showing the valve being opened and closed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which reduces value

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the date stamp on the cylinder to verify expiry date.
Photo of the valve and pressure gauge to check for damage or missing parts.
Photo of the inside of the cylinder to check for corrosion or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
